hero.title: Systems shaped with architectural judgment and product intent.
hero.description: DevJR presents engineering work through maintainable systems, operational clarity and software decisions designed to hold up beyond the first release.

sections.focusTitle: Structured around software that supports real operations
sections.focusDescription: The experience prioritizes context, trade-offs and delivery intent so each section is easy to scan and anchored in how systems behave in production.
sections.platformTitle: A clear boundary between product, services and data
sections.platformDescription: The narrative stays grounded in system structure rather than isolated features, reinforcing a maintainable and technically credible point of view.
sections.featuredProjectsDescription: Selected projects with architecture context, operational metrics and delivery intent.
sections.featuredPostsDescription: Notes on backend design, data movement, observability and pragmatic architecture.
sections.operatingTitle: Engineering framed around long-term system quality
sections.operatingDescription: The portfolio emphasizes the signals that matter when software must stay understandable, observable and useful under real operational pressure.
sections.operatingSignalsDescription: Work is shaped so teams can read system health, delivery impact and operational drift before problems become expensive.
sections.operatingBoundariesDescription: Interfaces, domain rules and supporting workflows are separated with enough discipline to keep change local and intent visible.
sections.operatingOutcomesDescription: The goal is not shipping features in isolation, but supporting teams and operators with software that remains dependable over time.
